verdict.rationale: Scribe is an API-first transcription service that runs without a UI. It offers a synchronous REST Fast mode, a WebSocket Live mode, and Batch jobs over S3 prefixes (up to 10,000 files, with glob filters and output placed beside inputs). It also issues API credentials with scopes, expiration and IP allowlists, which together support unattended, scripted automation. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific guidance and examples (e.g. pipeline recipes, non-interactive auth patterns for CI runners), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
